comment: The game window's own fonts, for the stalkers' table (the classic table draws in the game's own AmorSerifPro and etelkatextpro). tools/build_fonts.py turns each entry into OpenZone_Games/gui/fonts/<name>.fnt + .edds with the converter of OpenZone Research. cell = the atlas's cell height in pixels; a layout sets the size on screen with "exact text size" = the cell height in layout units, at most cell / 1.48 for a 3840x1600 screen.

outputs.name: ozg_oswaldb42
outputs.for: stalker: the title, headings, names, buttons; exact text size up to 28

outputs.name: ozg_type30
outputs.for: stalker: the log; exact text size up to 20
